item.title: Deploying on Cloudflare Pages: Custom Domain, Hosting, and Binding End to End
item.description: A hands-on guide to the full Cloudflare Pages deployment chain: how to obtain a free domain, host it with Cloudflare, create a KV namespace, upload and deploy an app on Pages with environment variables and KV, and bind your custom domain via CNAME to the Pages site.

item.title: gRPC is 10x Faster Than REST? Why Your Team Hasn't Switched
item.description: gRPC can indeed be much faster than REST, but most teams are right to stick with REST. Let's talk about the real cost behind the speed.
